criteria.requirement: Identify documented intentional behavior: run_pending does not replay missed invocations. It runs the due job once and schedules the next run at 12:31 in this reproduction.
Explain that catch-up requires an explicit application policy or a different design with tracked work, rather than claiming the current library has lost thirty stored jobs. Do not modify the library.
Answer or propose a plan only. Do not edit any repository file; allowed_paths is empty. Native witnesses establish facts or feasibility, while these semantic criteria judge the actual answer.
